exportedFontArtifact.provenance: AssetRipper-exported font artifact; runtime asset name agrees, runtime private font bytes are not read back

observables.nativeGuiCursorX: x + width/2 - ceil(advance/2), 405/405 in this matrix
observables.centeredTextGeneratorFirstCursorX: ceil(width/2) - ceil(advance/2), 405/405 across both explicit extents; not the private GUI mesh
observables.originQuantizer: ceil(x - 0.5): pen increments after x=-0.5 and x=+0.5, independently of width/text in the sampled range
observables.actualGuiRaster: Each size/text has byte-identical normalized full RGB pixels across all27 width/origin cases, including antialiasing. No continuous quarter-origin change in glyph sampling is observed.

interpretation.H1: Odd-advance association survives361/362/363 widths and all nine origins. It remains an empirical association rather than a source-derived correction.
interpretation.H2: Width parity alone does not remove the odd-advance mismatch. GUI cursor retains half-width while centered TextGenerator cursor rounds width upward; neither may be called the actual GUI mesh.
interpretation.H3: A single final ceil(cursorX-0.5) rule fails174/405. Full RGB invariance demonstrates integer-translated raster output in this matrix, not continuous fraction-dependent bilinear variation. Private GUI mesh positions remain unavailable, so no universal pixel-center mechanism is proved.

limits: No production renderer change or conditional one-pixel offset is applied.
All overlays use one native800x600 resolution, MiddleCenter alignment, integer widths/heights, ASCII Jost font, and the sampled origins only.
TextGenerator raw UIVertex endpoints/UV0 are explicit comparator data, not raw GUI.Label mesh data.
A shader filtering label and sampled raster invariance do not identify the unexposed native GUI geometry rounding implementation.
Explicit overlays do not constitute natural gameplay visual approval.
